    Source boundary / revision 1.0.0
    Reconstructed, with the evidence visible.
    Photo camera angles are approximate. Use the image and model together; visual agreement is not dimensional measurement.
    What this artifact establishes
    Published product envelope: 354.1 × 101.1 × 180.1 mm (X, Y, Z), converted and rounded from 13.94 × 3.98 × 7.09 inches. All geometry uses millimeters.
    Front control positions, shell slope, recess, knob sizes and joystick construction are photographic approximations. No CAD accuracy, button travel, encoder detents, physical angular limits or material measurement is claimed.
    Rear connector types are documented. Their selectable symbols float behind the enclosure as a schematic. Exact connector placement remains unverified.
    FMP camera reference: BirdDog P240, per the current user correction. Installed firmware, venue addresses and saved camera entries are not published here. Verify current settings at the device. The supplied firmware directory is not installation evidence.
    The powered image was reviewed for appearance only. It and the browser screenshot are not embedded because they display address information. No configuration or firmware binary is read by this artifact.
    SETUP identifies documented functions. A browser admin simulator is outside this version. Menu names, movement scales, preset destinations and motion timing here are simplified teaching behavior.
